Common Order:

(Per the Hon'ble the Chief Justice Hima Kohli)
1. Learned counsel for the petitioners states that in view of the fact that this court has closed almost all the matters pertaining to the Notifications issued by the Commissioner of Food Safety imposing prohibition of sale of certain tobacco and pan masala products under Section 30 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales)
Regulation, 2011, as the period under the said Notifications has since expired, he does not wish to press the present contempt petitions.
